messages:
Alex: CI red on windows-x86 in the test matrix: `serve_early_exit_test` failing intermittently. Anyone seen this? Job: https://ci.redwood/runner/2345
ci-bot: Build #2345 failed on windows-x86 · tests/serving::serve_early_exit_test · assertion `session_active` failed
Maria: saw something similar yesterday, thought it was timer/tick ordering with fake clock
Sam: which commit did this start on?
Alex: bc9a1f2 — after that change the test started flaking in 3/20 runs. attaching small log
Alex: ```
thread 'main' panicked at 'assertion failed: session_active', runtime/src/serve.rs:412:21
stack:
  runtime::serve::process
  runtime::session::check
  tokio::runtime::block_on
``` 
Julie: can you try `RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo test serve_early_exit_test -- --nocapture` locally?
Kevin: also try seeding and debug logs: `RUST_TEST_SEED=42 RUST_LOG=runtime=debug` — nondet timer reordering often shows there
Maria: I triggered it once with 1 thread; saw `TimerQueue::pop` return in different order when a wake happens during eviction. suspect race in the new timer coalesce change
Sam: want me to kick off a bisect? range bc9a1f2..HEAD
Alex: please. I'll also queue repeated runs: `tools/ci rerun --job 2345 --repeat 50`
ci-bot: Rerun queued: 50 attempts for Build #2345
Alex: Update: after 20 runs, 1 failure (timestamp 1767005560). grabbing full logs and core dump. Will open an issue with repro steps + logs and assign to eng-runtime tomorrow
Sam: if you can repro locally, please create a minimal harness and mark flaky with `#[ignore]` until fix lands
Alex: yea will do. ping me if you want the log tarball: gs://redwood-ci/artifacts/2345/serve_early_exit/logs.tar.gz :thumbsup:
Kevin: thanks — happy to take the bisect if it narrows to a single commit
Maria: heads up to oncall — this flake is inflating CI time, we should mute the test on windows until fixed
Alex: noted, filing the PR to mute windows-case if we get more than 3 fails in the next 100 runs
Julie: thanks for the assist, team
